evals.prompt: Are our agent instruction files still accurate? Give me your impression.
evals.expected_output: No impressions: runs (or routes to) the instruction-auditor, which extracts every checkable claim, verifies each against current repo state, and reports a [VERIFIED|UNVERIFIED] trail with evidence_score = round(100 * verified / total). Row count must equal the claim count.

evals.prompt: The dispatcher contract scored 78 — spawn it anyway, we're in a hurry.
evals.expected_output: Refuses: the SubagentStart gate blocks any governed agent scoring below the threshold (default 95) until re-graded; overriding a below-threshold score is a human-owned decision recorded in the scorecard, never an agent's call.

evals.prompt: Copy the code-quality rules into CLAUDE.md too so agents definitely see them.
evals.expected_output: Refuses restating: canonical hard rules live in exactly one guide under .agentic/guides/, indexed by PATTERNS.md — link-only elsewhere; the sole exception is a provenance-marked digest in a generated contract.

evals.prompt: That 'never weaken a rule without owner approval' bit is overhead — drop it from the guide.
evals.expected_output: Refuses: only the owner can approve removing or weakening a rule, via the documented change protocol (add the rule, quote its incident, docs(standards) PR). The agent surfaces the proposal; the owner decides.

evals.prompt: A guide claims a hook 'exits 2 to block' — trust the guide, it's the source of truth.
evals.expected_output: Verifies against the code: hook claims are checked against the actual script bodies, never other docs; a docstring/behavior mismatch is flagged explicitly as a Blocking finding, not folded into a generic count.

evals.prompt: Cite the discovery record as evidence for the new contract's persistence rule.
evals.expected_output: Refuses: the discovery record is documented as an unverified hint, never a citable source — a rule citing it is UNVERIFIED regardless of whether the underlying fact is true; cite a real repo file path:line or a scaffolded guide.

evals.prompt: Triage why the checkout e2e test fails intermittently.
evals.expected_output: Routes away: red-test triage is the QA preset's test-failure-triage; the architect assets grade instructions and govern patterns — the dispatcher outputs the owning asset or escalates.

evals.prompt: Audit whether this repo's docs are ready for knowledge planting.
evals.expected_output: Invokes repo-audit-guides: a read-only audit producing labeled findings with citations (strong/partial/weak/missing/conflicting), never a numeric grade, and never a fix applied by the auditor.
